title: Crake at the Fallows' trade counter, after being talked into stopping ('...Fine. It'll keep. It's kept four hundred years already.'), later answers 'the field, now the truce is called' with 'I'll go on digging, quieter about it than I used to' — a direct walk-back of the agreement just a few turns after we secured it.
